title: Use a bulk scorer for rescoring vectors

target.summary: When bulk-scoring vector candidates in batches of 32, if the remaining number of candidates for a scorer is smaller than the batch size, the bulk scorer attempts to read past the end of the candidate iterator, causing tests to fail on exhausted iterators.
